Based on the provided onboarding document, there is no mention of **Honcho** integration, memory isolation via Honcho, or passing user identity through `/v1/chat/completions`. 

**Best Guess:**
In standard OpenAI-compatible API setups like `/v1/chat/completions`, you typically pass user identifiers via the top-level `user` field in the request payload (or via custom HTTP headers/metadata). If Hermes or your proxy supports Honcho middleware or `pre_llm_call` plugin hooks, you may be able to intercept the request and route or inject the user context into Honcho, but this is not documented in the provided reference. For built-in native memory isolation, Hermes instead uses profiles (`hermes profile`) and markdown-based memory files (`USER.md`, `MEMORY.md`, `SOUL.md`).
